note: Generated by scripts/assumptions.mjs. Whole-pool and whole-population figures only; nothing from invited candidates.
sources: IRCC Express Entry pool by program and NOC, 2025 snapshot, as compiled by Maple Immigration Chronicles (Express Entry 2025: NOC Analytics). Secondary compilation; the four programs add up to the stated total.

Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, tables 98-10-0585-01 (employment income recipients by NOC 2021 minor group and immigrant status), 98-10-0449-01 (employed labour force by NOC 2021 unit group) and 98-10-0586-01 (median employment income by unit group)
IRCC Express Entry Year-End Report 2024, Table 17a: candidates in the pool who qualify for CBS criteria, as of Dec 1, 2024
IRCC Express Entry Year-End Report 2024, Table 3 (eligible profiles by additional point type) and fact sheet (category shares of eligible profiles)

rows.label: Whole pool
rows.basis: Canadian work: 66.3% of the pool is CEC-eligible. High-wage: 40.1% of temporary residents working in Canada in TEER 0-3 jobs (2021 Census, people-weighted). Job offers: 12.3% of 2024 profiles claimed one, times the high-wage share.

rows.label: Canadian Experience Class
rows.basis: 159,675 of 240,675 profiles in the pool were CEC-eligible. All have Canadian work, so they gain points at the scenario high-wage share.

rows.label: French language
rows.basis: 9% of eligible profiles submitted in 2024 met the French-language category. Canadian work and high-wage shares are the whole-pool scenario values.

rows.label: Health
rows.basis: 17,066 of 218,291 candidates in the pool qualified (Table 17a). 25.2% of temporary residents working in the category's 35 occupations are in one on IRCC's high-wage list. Only those with 12+ months of that work in Canada gain points.

rows.label: Trade
rows.basis: 7,742 of 218,291 candidates in the pool qualified (Table 17a). 6.6% of temporary residents working in the category's 10 occupations are in one on IRCC's high-wage list. Only those with 12+ months of that work in Canada gain points.

rows.label: Transport
rows.basis: 7,673 of 218,291 candidates in the pool qualified (Table 17a). 10.9% of temporary residents working in the category's 10 occupations are in one on IRCC's high-wage list. Only those with 12+ months of that work in Canada gain points.

rows.label: STEM
rows.basis: 41,880 of 218,291 candidates in the pool qualified (Table 17a). 97.8% of temporary residents working in the category's 24 occupations are in one on IRCC's high-wage list. Only those with 12+ months of that work in Canada gain points.

rows.label: Agri
rows.basis: 3,124 of 218,291 candidates in the pool qualified (Table 17a). 0.0% of temporary residents working in the category's 3 occupations are in one on IRCC's high-wage list. Only those with 12+ months of that work in Canada gain points.

rows.label: Senior managers
rows.basis: Every candidate has Canadian work as a senior manager (NOC 00010 to 00015); weighted by workers, nearly all are high-wage.

rows.label: Physicians
rows.basis: Every candidate has Canadian work as a physician (NOC 31100 to 31102); all three are in the 2x tier, worth +70.
